spans.s: + म् यथा-अनीक + म्, adv. as far as the host extended,
+ अर्थ यथा- + अर्थ, adj. 1. according to the sense. 2. proper, right, थम्, adv. suitably, properly.
यथेच्छम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + म्, adv. according to one's wish, Daśak. in
+ ईप्सा यथा- + ईप्सा, fem., instr. sing., according to one's desire,
+ उचित यथा- + उचित, adj. used,
+ म् यथा-उत्साह + म्, adv. according to one's power or ability,
+ म् यथा-उदय + म्, adv. in proportion to one's income, Yājñ. 2, 43.
+ म् यथा-उद्देश + म्, adv. according to the command,
+ उपजोषम् यथा- + उपजोषम्, adv. Satisfactorily,
यथोपदेशम्, i. e. यथा-उपदेश + म्, adv. according to the rule,
+ म् यथा-कथ + म्, adv. with following चिद्, by all means,
+ कर्मन् यथा- + कर्मन्, acc. adv. according to the work (allotted to them),
+ म् यथा-काम + म्, adv. at pleasure.
+ म् यथा-काल + म्, adv. At the proper time,
यथा-कॢप्ति, adv. in a suitable way,
+ म् यथा-क्रम + म्, adv. in due order,
Man. 3, 2
यथा-क्रम + म्, adv. In order, successively,
Vikr. 66, 21
+ म् यथा-गत + म्, adv., (returning in the same manner) as one came.
+ जात यथा- + जात, adj. foolish, a fool.
+ म् यथा-ज्येष्ठ + म्, adv. according to (their) rank, Pañc. 198, 10.
+ म् यथा-तत्त्व + म् adv. truly,
+ म् यथा-तथ + म्, adv. Properly, suitably.
+ म् यथा-दीक्ष + म्, adv. according to the religious observances,
+ म् यथापण्य + म्, adv. according to the value,
यथा-पूर्वम्, adv. 1. as before, Pañc. 36, 18. 2. formerly. 3. in order or succession.
+ म् यथा-प्रधान + म्, adv. according to their chiefs, represented by their chiefs, Johns.
+ प्राप्ति यथा- + प्राप्ति, adj. as justified, suitable,
(cf. प्राप्त, i. e. प्र-आप्त, proper, right; perhaps with Schlegel, corr. यथाप्राप्ति, adv.).
+ म् यथा-फल + म्, when bearing fruit, Pañc. i. d. 246.
+ म् यथा-बल + म्, adv. to the utmost of one's power, Johns.
यथा-मति, adv. according to one's understanding or intellect, Vedāntas. in

य + था (यद्), adv.
 1. In which manner, like, as, Hit. pr. 38, M.M.;
; with following तद् एरम्, As--just so,

. With following तथा, In every way, Hit. ii. d. 138.
 3. As truly as (a form of asseveration),

(literally: ‘As truly I love nobody but thee, so truly I touch my head,’ i. e. ‘As I touch my head, so I [] love nobody but thee’).
 4. In order that, that,

. It is used often as introduction to a direct sentence, Śāk. 7, 1, bel. ज्ञायते यथायम् आभोगस् तपोवनस्येति, ‘One perceives these are the environs of a forest of ascetics.’
 6. Doubled, यथायथा, In what proportion,

. Very often it is the former part of comp. adv., of which the latter part has the form of an acc. sing. n.; they may be resolved by supplying ‘is,’ and generally translated by ‘according to that which is implied by the latter part,’ e. g. यथा-काम + म्, literally, ‘as is desire,’ ‘according to one's wish,’ ‘at pleasure, ad libitum,’

. यथा-यथ + म्, adv. Properly, suitably (ŚKD.).
 --Comp.
यथा-दिश् + अ + म्, adv. In all directions,
यथाभीष्टदिशम्, i. e. यथा-अभि-इष्ट-दिश् + अ + म् (vb. इष्), adv. In whatever direction one lists, Pañc. 63, 2.
यथार्थाक्षर, i. e. यथा-अर्थ-अक्षर, adj. Of which the letters imply the true sense. Vikr. d. 1.
यथावकाशम्, i. e. यथा-अवकाश + म्, adv. When there is any opportunity,
यथार्हतस्, i. e. यथा-अर्ह + तस्, adv. Justly,

यथा + वत्, adv.
 1. Exactly as it was, truly,
. According to law,
. Accordingly, suitably,
Nal. 6, 8
यथेच्छकम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + क + म्, and यथेच्छम् [] यथेच्छम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + म् (cf. इच्छा), adv. As one lists, Pañc. 192, 13.
यथेष्टतस्, i. e. यथा-%इष्ट (vb. इष्), + तस्, adv. According to will or inclination,

Ragh. 10, 25
+ म् यथा-योग + म्, adv. in due order,
+ म् यथा-रस + म्, adv. according to the sentiments,
Mālav. 20, 20
+ वर्ण यथार्ह- + वर्ण, i. e. यथा-अर्ह-, m. a spy.
+ म् यथा-वास + म्, adv. as far as to one's own abode, home.
+ विध यथा- + विध, adj. of what sort, how like.
+ विधि यथा- + विधि, adv. according to rule, Pañc. iii. d. 162.
+ म् यथा-वृत्त + म्, adv. relating a thing as it happened, circumstantially, truly,
+ म् यथा-व्यवहार + म्, adv. conformably to custom,
+ शक्ति यथा- + शक्ति, adv. to the utmost of one's power, Hit. ii. d. 51;
Lass. 59, 1
+ म् यथा-शास्त्र + म्, adv. as the law ordains,
+ म् यथा-श्रद्ध + म्, adv. confidently, without reserve,
Nal. 4, 1
+ श्रुति यथा- + श्रुति, adv. conformable to the precepts of the Vedas, Śāk. d. 152.
+ म् यथा-सङ्ग + म्, adv. so as to be adapted.
(the door lifts itself as much as is necessary far his entering it without bowing).
+ म् यथा-समय + म्, adv. according to established custom, Johns.
+ म् यथा-सुख + म्, adv. 1. happily,
. willingly,
